field.p: We provide a hosting account on our infrastructure, at the plan and billing period you selected at checkout. Your plan's storage, bandwidth, and other limits are as described on the product page.

Your plan bills automatically at the interval you selected (monthly, quarterly, or yearly) for as long as your service remains active. If you saved a payment method at checkout, we will attempt to charge it automatically on each renewal. If a renewal charge fails, or you pay by a method we can't charge automatically, your account is suspended after 7 days of non-payment and, if still unpaid, permanently terminated (including deletion of its data) after a further 30 days suspended. You can avoid this at any time by bringing your account current.
You agree not to use this hosting service to:

ul.li: Attempt to gain unauthorized access to any system, or disrupt or overload shared infrastructure used by other customers;
Send or facilitate spam, or send email in violation of Section 4 below.

field.p: We may suspend an account immediately, without the grace periods in Section 2, if it is being used in a way that threatens the security or availability of our infrastructure or other customers' accounts.
If your hosting plan includes email, you agree to the following, in addition to any applicable anti-spam law (such as CAN-SPAM in the United States or CASL in Canada):

ul.li: No unsolicited bulk or commercial email. You may not use this hosting service to send unsolicited bulk email ("spam") to recipients who have not asked to hear from you.

Every recipient can unsubscribe. Any marketing, newsletter, or bulk email you send through this hosting must include a clear, working way for the recipient to unsubscribe or opt out of future messages, and you must honor an unsubscribe request promptly - normally within 10 business days, and never later than any applicable law requires.

Accurate sender information. Email you send must accurately identify you or your organization as the sender and must not use a forged or misleading "From" address, subject line, or routing information.

field.p: A violation of this section may result in immediate suspension of your email service, or your whole account, without the grace periods in Section 2.

You are responsible for keeping your account password confidential and for all activity on your account. You are responsible for your own backups of anything you consider important; while we take reasonable measures to protect data on our infrastructure, we do not guarantee against data loss.

You may cancel your service at any time; cancelling stops future billing but does not refund the current billing period. We may terminate your account for a violation of Section 3 or 4, or under the non-payment schedule in Section 2. Terminating an account deletes its data on our infrastructure; we are not able to recover it afterwards.
